findings.summary: Fix only reaches --help; body and CHANGELOG claim it also fixes normal file display, which is false
MSYSTEM env heuristic makes --help output colored when piped or redirected inside any MSYS2 shell, breaking pipe detection
Root cause and version history in the body are unsupported and contradict the CHANGELOG; no evidence from a real mintty run
Lean: is_some_and, drop cfg(not(windows)) stub, inline check and shorten comment

why: Finding 2 states the maintainer's reason in substance: the mintty/MSYSTEM override colors output when stdout is a pipe or redirect, so piping is broken. It is the second finding in the review's order.
